limitations: 3.0.0/exact_pressure_v3 under pressure-2 semantics. Admitted families: small-displacement homogeneous-isotropic straight circular pipe members (shear deformation as the contract declares: euler_bernoulli, or timoshenko_annulus_energy_v1 with the energy-matched annular shear factor, whose nodal rotations are section rotations; G is derived from E/nu) and linear restraints or springs; realized curved bends are Euler-Bernoulli under either shear model and, with expansion joints authored as objective connectors, are admitted only as the bend and connector limitations state; valve, flange, rigid and specialty components are admitted as their mapped straight member with the user's DEC-045 stiffness scale, an equivalent pipe of the mapped section whose stress rows are those of that reference section (marked component_body), not a body stress, and reducers when their mapped member lies outside every pressure region or forms a pressure step, the only member of its own region between single straight members of other regions with transfers_to_wall at both ends, either concentric and collinear or eccentric or slanted with W-15c's run evidence and any read offset accepted, whose junction caps at the actual nodes along each member's own axis carry the step's pressure force and moment (EXACT_PRESSURE_REDUCER_IN_REGION otherwise); a branch connection (tee) is a record at its node, whose members meet as a rigid joint with no branch flexibility; a tee consumed as mechanics_geometry_only gives its user-entered header and branch SIFs as intensified rows at the ends of its named straight members on each section basis, not a code stress, and a realized arc it names carries none; a constant-effort support (DEC-049) declaring exactly one translational DOF and a finite positive constant load is consumed: it has zero stiffness and applies that load as a constant nodal force along the DOF's positive global axis in every solved case, and a mechanics combination over a model with one is withheld (CONSTANT_EFFORT_COMBINATION_REQUIRES_SOLVE) when a factor is not finite or the exact factor sum is not within 64 epsilon of 1; a record that is not consumed applies nothing and warns (SUPPORT_CONSTANT_EFFORT_NOT_CONSUMED). Pressure regions meeting at a node where every terminal transfers to the wall form a junction, whose caps sum to the fitting's pressure load. Section bases: stiffness and pipe metal mass use the nominal wall; contents mass and pressure end-cap areas use the reduced bore; every stress row is published on the nominal section and on the reduced section (wall minus mill tolerance and corrosion allowance) and names its basis, and each basis has its own maximum and headline; no governing basis is chosen. Each basis's Lamé stresses are those of its own annulus, while the axial membrane stress divides the one wall force by that basis's area. Every other component or support family is refused by name (EXACT_PRESSURE_FAMILY_NOT_ADMITTED) until a later contract revision admits it.

Pressure is a signed internal differential with zero external pressure increment, uniform within each explicit case-scoped collinear equal-bore region with explicit closure-transfer paths. A negative differential is admitted, but external-pressure stability and collapse are not assessed.
Not modelled: steady-flow momentum and transient pressure loads; bend opening under pressure (Bourdon effect); pressure stiffening of flexibility factors and stress intensification; ovalization.
Mechanical, pressure-eigen and cap-transfer contributions remain distinct; rounded cap/eigen ledgers are observational and do not replace source-grouped pressure assembly.
Structural line loads act as entered; contents density does not imply hydrostatic pressure head or a coupled static-fluid pressure/weight state.

Signed support actions are attributed only for admitted linear restraints and springs and, as its constant force, for a consumed constant-effort support; ambiguous coincident rigid attribution is refused.
The circular normal-stress maximum bounds the supplied binary64 polynomial coefficient enclosures; solution error is separate, and incomplete coverage withholds the headline.

Every member section declares its corrosion allowance and the contract declares its shear model. This envelope publishes ordinary structural recovery. Retained-source recovery is available only for straight members, linear restraints or springs, nodal force and moment loads and explicitly empty pressure regions; an authored load/reference-state group includes resolved eigenloads and prescribed motions. Other source families are declined by name. No code compliance or professional acceptance is produced, and actual numerical admission remains separate.

Member actions, section actions, stresses and support reactions of a load case reported NUMERICAL_INTEGRITY_CHECKS_PASSED are recovered at 128-bit precision from the formation check's corrected displacement and rounded once; they are not binary64 recomputations from the solve's own displacement, from which they may differ by about 1e-12 of the body's action scale (at most about 6e-9 in the evaluation sets).

The recovery is checked against the formation check's re-formed system (stiffness and loads formed at 128-bit precision from the binary64 inputs). Wherever the formation check produced its member bound for a load case, including a case that the member recovery check then reports as sensitive, each published nodal displacement component is the corrected displacement (the solve's displacement plus the check's two correction terms, summed exactly) rounded once to binary64 in SI units and then converted to the published unit as every other row is, and each displacement magnitude is the correctly rounded norm of the node's three published translation components; where there is no such bound, or where any component of the case cannot be formed, every published displacement of the case is the solve's own, and a selected retained source publishes its recovery's nodal values. Support reactions balance the re-formed loads, not the solve's binary64 load vector.
